## Stakes (Extrapolating) {#intro}

Extrapolated notes. This M2 seminar (6 ECTS) has two faces: **ethical issues** (bias, surveillance, accountability, governance) and **novel AI applications** — including where Graph×LLM changes the impact surface (agents, multimodal, sensitive relational data).

Empirically, after a technical year, ethics risks becoming a final slide. Here it is a work object: cases, readings, argumentation — in dialogue with humanities and M2 safety / privacy / explainability modules.

## Place in the 2-year path {#place}

**Upstream**: M1/M2 humanities, possible responsible modules in P2, research internship. **Parallel**: M2 LLMs, GNN, geometric DL, privacy/security. **Downstream**: transverse project and final internship, where ethical trade-offs become operational again.

## Industry and research links {#industrie}

**Industry**: AI governance, risk & compliance, product red-teaming, usage policies. **Research**: fairness, privacy attacks, socio-technical studies — and fast-moving novel applications (agents, generative + graphs).

## How to approach it {#travailler}

-   For each case, separate technical facts, conflicting values, and action options (design, policy, abstention).
-   Link to [Privacy / uncertainty](../m2-privacy-uncertainty/index.html), [Security & robustness](../m2-security-robustness/index.html), [Explainability / security / privacy of LLMs](../m2-explainability-security-privacy-llms/index.html) when present in the repo.

[Extrapolating]{.tag} Framing; session syllabus = official seminar.
